title: Can Claude replace Chaser? 18/18 checks, 83 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Chaser alternative, an invoice reminder tool with CSV import, a reminder schedule from a heads-up to a final notice, one email per customer per day and an aging report, from one written spec: all 18 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 83 gaps in the spec.

The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/invoice-reminders
Chaser pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/chaser

Chaser prices (US, by company revenue): Compact $233 a month billed yearly ($259 monthly) for revenue under $5 million and 4 users; Core $700 a month billed yearly ($779 monthly) for revenue under $13 million with unlimited users; Complete $1,050 a month billed yearly ($1,169 monthly), adding a receivables forecast (chaserhq.com/chaser-pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
